description:
Umbrella for the three unfinished fast-follow epics left behind by shipped releases. Each child epic carries the findings its release deliberately did not take.

- specled_-scb — fast-follow of specled_-k6s (PR #32 / release 0.11.0 / main c2d21349). 4 children. NOTE: the dn4.12 and vbo branches are based on 2d4535c1, which is NOT an ancestor of squashed main — rebase with a cold worker before resuming.
- specled_-bg5 — fast-follow of specled_-q0q (PR #34 / release 0.13.0 / main 9adbac9c). 6 children from the 2026-08-06 critical review.
- specled_-vzd — fast-follow of specled_-n5q (PR #35 / release 0.14.0 / main bb64e69e). 6 children from the 2026-08-11 critical review.

Purpose: one place to see and sequence the accumulated post-release debt, so fast-follows get scheduled deliberately instead of aging out of `bw ready`. Suggested order is oldest-first (scb, then bg5, then vzd) since scb is the only one carrying rebase risk that grows with time.

No new work is defined here; this epic closes when all three child epics close.

Advances: specled.api_boundary, specled.realized_by

comments.text:
Orchestration started (flattened mode).

Epic worktree: /Users/mz/src/specled_ex-fast-follow-backlog
Branch: specled_-i4x/fast-follow-backlog
Base SHA: bb64e69e6832264eb202d01fa48b63dda5e69b5b
Smoke at base: GREEN (1323 tests, 3 properties, 0 failures)

Operator decisions for this run:
- Scope: flattened — all 16 leaves across scb/bg5/vzd driven as one DAG under this epic.
- Decision-class tickets (vzd.1, bg5.1, vbo and any similar): the implementer drafts
  the decision + ADR as a proposal; the work is graded normally but is NOT merged.
  It waits for human sign-off at finish.

Tooling note: bin/rigor-check, pipeline-config, and gate-memo are NOT installed in this
repo/host. Consequences, applied for the whole run:
- No mechanical simple/critical authority, so every ticket is CRITICAL by the canonical
  rubric's default-when-unsure. No simple path; full grader ladder on every child.
- merge-batching is OFF, so merge gates run per-close.
- No gate memoization; every gate executes.

Known-red baselines: none (CLAUDE.md has no "Known Baseline Gate Exceptions" section).
Nothing is waivable this run.

CONTRACT SYNTHESIS COMPLETE — all 16 leaves. DAG below.

Three cold read-only analysts synthesized Advances / Allowed touches / Out of Scope (files) /
Out of Scope (intent) / Verification onto every leaf. Findings that changed the plan:

TICKET DEFECTS CORRECTED (the review findings were written as prose, not contracts):
- bg5.4 cited a "rejected" ADR status. No such status exists — the schema enum is
  ~w(accepted deprecated superseded) (lib/specled_ex/schema/decision.ex:5). Live exposure is
  deprecated + superseded. Re-chartered against those.
- bg5.5's premise was materially overstated. The :info COUNT is always printed with an explicit
  "info hidden; --verbose to show" disclosure (lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex:252-257), spec'd
  since 0.8.0. Only the DETAIL line is hidden, and the flag is --verbose, not --debug.
- vzd.1's prescribed fix does not fix its stated defect: on a seeding run there is no committed
  entry, so no divergence finding exists for that MFA, so a per-MFA gate never fires. OPERATOR
  RE-CHARTERED to a run-scoped gate.
- vzd.3 shrinks by an order of magnitude: there is NO persisted append-only baseline to migrate
  (append_only.spec.md:9-11 — it is reconstructed per run), so no digest storage and no
  migration story. ~50 lines of detector; the cost is the budget justification.
- vzd.4's Advances was incomplete (1 subject listed, 3 actually spanned).
- vzd.6's Advances was wrong: specled.package is the distributed-artifact subject. OPERATOR
  MOVED it to specled.decisions as ADR-reference discipline.

HARD BLOCKER FOUND, PREVIOUSLY UNRECORDED: specled_-bos had NO blocked_by edge, but
test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs — the only file it edits — does not exist at the epic
base. It is created by dn4.12. A worker dispatched on bos would have found nothing. Edge added.

DEPENDENCY EDGES ADDED THIS RUN:
  bg5.1 -> bg5.4 -> bg5.6      (all three must change authorizing_decision/2; bg5.1 settles the
                                authorization contract first)
  bg5.2 -> bg5.6
  vzd.4 -> vzd.2 -> vzd.1      (vzd.4 F13 renames drift_dangling_pairs/1, which vzd.2 reshapes)
  vzd.4 -> vzd.6               (vzd.4 deletes the very comment blocks vzd.6 would lint)
  dn4.12 -> bos                (NEW — hard blocker above)
  dn4.12 -> zd8                (pre-existing, re-verified against the actual diff)

ACCEPTED PRIORITY INVERSION: vzd.4 is P4 and vzd.2 is P3, but vzd.4 must land first. The
alternative is a guaranteed same-hunk conflict on the hot path.

OPERATOR DECISIONS RECORDED:
- vzd.1 -> re-charter to a run-scoped divergence gate (not the ticket's per-MFA gate).
- vzd.6 -> Advances: specled.decisions, not specled.package.
- vbo  -> drop Level C entirely, including its "deploy must not invoke mix" assertion; its
          helpers are the same run:-text-matching class that failed three times.

HELD FOR HUMAN SIGN-OFF (drafted and graded, but NOT merged): bg5.1, bg5.4, bg5.5, vzd.1,
vzd.3, vzd.6, vbo. Each needs a spec amendment or an ADR that changes what specled promises.

REBASE RESOLUTION (the two parked branches):
- dn4.12: a whole-branch rebase was the WRONG move — it replays 24 commits, 21 of which already
  landed in the 0.11.0 squash, manufacturing conflicts in package.spec.md and CLAUDE.md that
  belong to neither ticket. Correct operation is a cherry-pick of 2d4535c1..400839c3 (3 commits).
  DONE: clean, 6 files, +203/-113, .spec/realization_hashes.json untouched.
- vbo: merge-tree against the epic base is conflict-free in every class. Rebase then PRUNE
  rather than re-implement — ~150 lines both graders certified sound at iteration 3.

ORCHESTRATOR NOTE — contract/cadence conflict, resolved in favour of the cadence fence.

I wrote "mix test (FULL suite)" into specled_-vzd.4's Verification section, reasoning that a
four-part behavior-preservation claim deserves wide scope. That instruction is unsatisfiable by
a delegated implementer: the cadence block in delegated-implementer.md explicitly forbids a
per-ticket full-suite run and defers whole-system proof to the merge gate, and cx-implementer
BYTE-COMPARES that block against the canonical template before launching, so it cannot be
softened per-ticket even deliberately.

The implementer did the right thing — ran `mix test --stale` plus the three focused realization
files (98 tests) and left the full suite alone.

Resolution: the full-suite obligation for vzd.4 moves to this epic's per-close merge gate, which
runs it anyway. I briefed the verifier explicitly NOT to report the missing full-suite run as a
Gap, so it does not bounce a ticket for obeying its own template.

Standing correction for the rest of this run: a ticket contract's Verification section may ADD
targeted commands, but must never demand the full suite. If a ticket genuinely needs
whole-system proof, that is the merge gate's job and should be stated as a merge-gate note, not
an implementer instruction. No other contract in this epic carries a full-suite line; vzd.4 was
the only one.
